'''Vultee-Pietsch''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was one of at least three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the massive [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Kleeva]].
